notes: Outbound lists have no form submitter, so routes are about call order. First matching rule wins. Nothing is sent automatically.

rules.name: no_data
rules.action: No usable website data. Verify the business and find the owner before any call.

rules.name: low_confidence
rules.action: Evidence is thin, so the score is provisional. Find the owner and the basics (headcount, vehicles, client buildings) before calling.

rules.name: high
rules.action: Top of the list. Find the owner via the search link, then call using the opener.

rules.name: medium
rules.action: Possible fit. Call after the High group, or when the owner is easy to reach.

rules.name: low
rules.action: Likely not a fit. Skip unless new information appears.
